summary: A native iPhone app in Objective-C and UIKit, for teams maintaining or extending Objective-C code, with strict warnings, the static analyzer and XCTest.
description: Start an iPhone app in modern Objective-C: ARC, nullability annotations, lightweight generics and designated initializers, with UIKit views built in code on the scene lifecycle. XcodeGen generates the Xcode project, every compiler warning fails the build, and the Clang static analyzer is a check of its own. One screen loads a greeting through a service protocol and shows loading, content and error states, with an error domain that maps each failure to a message. XCTest covers the logic and the screen, an XCUITest smoke test launches the app, clang-format checks style, and one Swift file shows how Objective-C and Swift call each other. It has no backend, accounts or storage.
seoDescription: An Objective-C iPhone app recipe: UIKit in code, XcodeGen, nullability, warnings as errors, Clang static analyzer, XCTest, XCUITest and a Swift interop seam.

projectExamples.title: Field inspection checklist

projectExamples.title: Barcode lookup for a C++ scanning library
